prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high in four of the six rounds, though rounds 5 and 7 were under-predicted.
Sign-in reorder changes are helpful, averaging +3.0% after noise correction across three tests, with two winning tests and one showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed despite winning.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +5.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Screen Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a split card layout comparing preset companions and custom pet photo creation options. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and custom pet generation errors cause dropoff and support complaints.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Companion Greeting Screen: Insert a new interactive greeting screen in the finish step where users can click their pet before it lands on desktop. (why: Three support emails report confusion on how to interact or talk with the pet after completing setup.)
2: [home, new_flow] Progressive Generation Status Flow: Add a live status preview with clear progress indicators on the waiting screen while pet rendering completes. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and custom pet generation stalls generate user friction and support tickets.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Companion Path Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout showcasing desktop pet interactive highlights before path selection. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with a high mean time of 514s, showing initial friction.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Warning: Add a helpful sign-in hint explaining that using the same account keeps existing pets saved across desktop sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification Option: Enable desktop notifications when pet generation completes while the app is in the background. (why: Waiting screen mean time is extremely long (2336s), suggesting users minimize and forget the window.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Overlay Troubleshooting Note: Display a troubleshooting hint on home_intro explaining how to summon the pet if it does not show up on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop after completing onboarding.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Upload Hint: Add photo lighting and angle guidance on the photo upload screen to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Progress Step Indicator: Enable step counters and progress tracking on the choose_path screen to set clear time expectations. (why: Drop-off at choose_path is high with an average time of 514s, indicating uncertainty about setup length.)
9: [finish, incentive] Starter Pet Care Incentive Badge: Display a highlighted welcome badge detailing unlocked interactive companion features on the intro screen. (why: Finish step dropoff is 26.5% and users report confusion about post-onboarding pet capabilities.)
